About Us
HOTEL DEEPA
COMFORTS
Luxury Redfined
Welcome to the Hotel Deepa Comforts, your ideal heaven for business, conference, banquets, leisure, vacation and celebration. Our three-star hotel combines comfort, convenience, and contemporary amenities to cater to the diverse needs of our guests, where each individual is given service with unobtrusive consideration and care. The commitment to impeccable service expresses itself in the meticulous attention to detail in the coordination of everything from business appointments to travel arrangements.
The Hotel is fully equipped for business class travelers with Wi-Fi internet access, three exclusive food and beverages outlets, luxurious banquet halls to conduct your various business meetings to memorable events, travel desk and 24 hours room service. Our courteous staff works round the clock managing the most demanding requirements of our guests. Our continuing efforts towards quality makes us distinguished among the hotels in Mangalore.
Mr. Ramesh Kumar & Mrs. Urmila Ramesh Kumar
Message from the Managing Directors
Mr. Ramesh Kumar, Managing Director of Hotel Deepa Comforts is a distinguished property developer and hospitality magnate with an impressive career spanning over 40 years. As a prominent figure in Mangalore's real estate and hospitality industry, he has constructed over 35 Apartment buildings and commercial places in and around Mangalore. Mr. Kumar has established himself as a dedicated and accomplished individual with a proven track record of excellence.
Mr. Kumar's entrepreneurial spirit led him to establish Janatha Constructions and its affiliated companies, which have carved a niche for them in Mangalore's real estate landscape. His foray into the hospitality industry began with the launch of Hotel Deepa Comforts in 2008, a 3-star hotel that has become a benchmark for excellence in Mangalore.
Mrs. Urmila Ramesh Kumar had begun her professional journey in the nationalized bank, where she developed her skills and gained valuable experience. Subsequently, she transitioned to the hospitality industry, assuming the role of Managing Director at Hotel Deepa Comforts, her commitment to excellence is evident in her various roles, including her current positions as President of Vishwa Billava Mahila Sangha and Vice President of Kudroli Shree Gokarnanatha Kshethra in Mangalore.
Under Mr. & Mrs Kumar's leadership, Hotel Deepa Comforts has earned a reputation for its high-quality food, prompt and personalized service, immaculate atmosphere, and affordable pricing. The hotel's commitment to excellence has been recognized through numerous awards and accolades from both state and national governments. Their legacy continues to inspire and influence the next generation of entrepreneurs and business leaders.
Welcome to Hotel Deepa Comforts, where luxury meets comfort and exceptional service. We are delighted to introduce our hotel as your home away from home.
At Hotel Deepa Comforts, we strive to provide an unforgettable experience for our guests. Our team is dedicated to ensuring that every moment of your stay with us is nothing short of extraordinary. From our elegantly designed rooms to our world-class amenities, every detail has been carefully crafted to exceed your expectations. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, we invite you to indulge in our warm hospitality and unparalleled service. Explore our website to discover more about our hotel, and we look forward to personally welcoming you to Hotel Deepa comforts soon.

Services
Experience the ultimate in comfort and luxury at Hotel Deepa Comforts, where our warm hospitality and exceptional service guarantee a memorable stay. Savor a rich culinary journey with our signature restaurant, serving delectable local and international cuisine for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Unwind with an expertly crafted cocktail or fine wine at our stylish bar, where every moment is a delight. We offer the finest experiences, tailored to surpass your expectations.
Business
Seamless Support for Your Success
Hotel Deepa Comforts Mangalore offers an oasis of serenity, providing impeccable service and meticulous attention to detail for business travelers. Strategically located in the heart of the city, the hotel provides easy access to business districts and key locations. It features modern amenities like Wi-Fi, a 24-hour business center, exclusive dining outlets, and a well-equipped health club. With round-the-clock service and a unique blend of Indian and Asian hospitality, Hotel Deepa Comforts ensures a memorable and comfortable stay for all guests.
Travel & Concierge
Unforgettable Journeys Begin Here
Hotel Deepa Comforts Mangalore offers a comprehensive travel desk service, providing guided city sightseeing, air ticket reconfirmation, airport pick-up and drop-off, and car rentals. The hotel also arranges reservations outside Mangalore and can provide multilingual guides upon request. With 24-hour service, the travel desk is dedicated to managing every aspect of your travel plans, ensuring a smooth and convenient experience. Mangalore, Karnataka's fastest-growing coastal city, serves as the political and business hub of the state, offering a unique blend of culture and modern development.
Beauty & Wellness
Indulge in inner & Outer Radiance
Hotel Deepa Comforts Mangalore offers a wide range of spa services, including pedicure/manicure (spa and regular), hair treatments (hairfall, spa dandruff, and damage), hair setting, henna application, anti-aging and face lifting treatments (including international options), and bridal makeovers. Additional services include threading, waxing (international and normal), body massage, body polish, and facials (acne treatments and pigmentation care). With a full suite of spa services, the hotel provides guests with a luxurious and rejuvenating experience.
Health & Fitness
Stay Active, Stay Empowered
Hotel Deepa Comforts Mangalore offers a well-equipped health club featuring treadmills, cardio machines, elliptical trainers, and yoga mats. The facilities are designed to support a wide range of fitness goals, including weight loss or gain. Guests can enjoy a balanced workout experience with access to modern equipment for their fitness needs, ensuring a healthy and active stay during their time at the hotel.

Banquet Halls
Welcome to the elegant banquet halls of Hotel Deepa Comforts, where sophistication meets versatility. Our spacious, well-appointed venue is ideal for a range of events, from corporate meetings and conferences to weddings and social celebrations. With contemporary decor and state-of-the-art audiovisual equipment, the halls can accommodate a variety of setups to suit your needs. Our Hotel consists of two luxurious high capacity banquet halls
(Shehnai and Senate)
for large gatherings and three customizable medium capacity halls
(Moments, Baithak and Board Room)
to suit corporate needs. We also house a very large capacity open air terrace venue
(Sky Lounge)
for outdoor programmes. The in house catering provides delicious cuisines to the guests which makes the events, meetings and gatherings memorable. Our dedicated event planning team is committed to ensuring every detail is perfect, from custom catering options to seamless service. Whether you’re hosting an intimate gathering or a grand affair, our banquet hall offers a refined atmosphere and exceptional support to make your event memorable and successful. Experience the perfect blend of style and functionality at Hotel Deepa Comforts.
